description: A bathroom after a haircut. The white basin, the marble counter and the mirror are smeared all over with clippings of black hair; loose hair is stuck to the glass and lies in drifts on the floor. A man in a white vest wipes the counter and the basin with a grey cloth, rinses it under the tap, then wipes the mirror clean in wide strokes. By the end the mirror is clear, the marble is bare and the basin is white again, with a single spray bottle standing on the counter.

de.answer: Er wischt die verdreckte Ablage mit einem Tuch ab.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está limpiando la encimera mugrienta con un paño.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il essuie le plan de toilette crasseux avec un chiffon.
